body:
Parent: https://github.com/Cratis/.github/issues/24

## Context

`Cratis/AI` has been rewritten into a corpus-only repository, but several retained defaults still assume the deleted Planner application exists. These defaults are propagated to consuming repositories and can silently disable validation.

## Work

- [ ] Replace Planner-specific entries in `.ai/hooks/scripts/quality-gates.json` (`Planner.slnx`, `Source/Planner`) with generic project discovery or a documented override model.
- [ ] Remove or rework the obsolete package-update workflow now that AI has no package manifests.
- [ ] Correct hook/readme examples that refer to `Source/Planner`, `Source/**/*.cs` in this repository, or the deleted `planner-build.yml`.
- [ ] Decide and document whether `.pi/**` is a propagated adapter surface under the new corpus model.
- [ ] Trim or anchor broad `.gitignore` patterns that can hide legitimate corpus paths such as `out`, `dist`, or `coverage`.
- [ ] Resolve the local semantic `.pi/tasks/` ignore change separately from unrelated formatter-only diffs.
- [ ] Record the explicitly authorized one-off history-rewrite exception so the normal append-only rule remains credible.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A clean clone passes `.ai/hooks/scripts/validate-ai-setup.sh`.
- [ ] Default quality gates can activate in a representative application, framework, and corpus-only repository without product-specific paths.
- [ ] No scheduled workflow is a known no-op that unnecessarily receives an organization PAT.
- [ ] Documentation accurately describes the repository's current corpus-only role and supported adapters.
title: Make the rewritten AI repository coherently corpus-only
